jobs_results.title: Junior Back-end Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We​ ​are​ ​growing​ ​again!​ ​At​ ​mediasmart​ ​we​ ​are​ ​looking​ ​for​ a ​Junior backend developer (entry-level position)​ ​to​ ​join​ ​our tech​ ​team.

We are looking for a person willing to learn our technology stack and our business. We expect a good grasp of modern Javascript but we will teach you what is needed from our stack. Reporting to the head of backend, you will partake in our backend dev team.

mediasmart started in January 2012 and is one of the most innovative platforms in the mobile programmatic advertising space. VC funded in its origin, mediasmart is now part of Affle International (Singapore), a global consumer intelligence technology company that has Microsoft, D2C (An NTT DoCoMo, Dentsu & NTT Advertising JV), Itochu, Bennett Coleman & Company (BCCL) as shareholders, and whose Indian subsidiary trades on the India stock exchanges (BSE: 542752 & NSE: AFFLE).

mediasmart has offices in Madrid, Paris, and New York. Since its inception, mediasmart has always been... very clear on its position in the mobile advertising ecosystem: full focus on advertisers and the buying process. Today we are the first programmatic platform that allows advertisers to measure the incremental impact of their drive to store and app promotion campaigns in real time, so that they can invest more in what really helps them grow their business.

mediasmart was one of the first players to enter the programmatic mobile ecosystem and to date our proprietary technology stack comprises of a DSP, DMP & Ad-Server, as well as direct connections to more than 30 ad exchanges where we buy display, video, audio and native ads on mobile apps, web, smart TV and desktop.

Our culture and values
• Be a generous leader. One that helps others succeed and celebrate their success.
• Love curiosity. Keep learning and stay relevant.
• It’s a team effort. Collaborate and cooperate to build a smart company.
• Go farther. Be an example for others. Set the bar.
• Love what we do. Love our work with passion and respect.
• Do good and do well. Our work matters.

We work hard and never forget to have fun in the process. Absolutely devoted to our customers and to building the best mobile advertising company out there, our passion shines through everything we do.

Junior Backend developer

We are looking for a person willing to learn our technology stack and our business. This is an entry level position. We expect a good grasp of modern Javascript but we will teach you what is needed from our stack. Reporting to the head of backend, you will partake in our backend dev team.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop new functionalities and maintain our product.
• Deliver new code fast and reliably, and always ensure that it works in production.
• Be able to promptly solve issues directly in the existing code.
• Proactively analyse areas to improve and propose projects to make our product more effective.

Desired Skills & Experience
• Knowledge of JavaScript and some other language.
• Some experience with Git version control.
• Basic Linux administration.
• Good communication skills, oral and written.
• Proactivity, critical thinking and good disposition for working in teams.
• Fluent in English.

Bonus Experience
• Experience with Node.js.
• Experience with Go.
• Experience with NoSQL and big data databases: BigQuery, Redis, RocksDB...
• Experience in cloud computing like AWS or GCP.
• Interest in machine learning and statistics.

Don’t worry if you lack some of the requirements; we would teach you everything needed rather than passing on the right person.

What we offer
• Competitive salary.
• Permanent contract.
• Career plan.
• Courses (related online or offline courses you might like).
• Remote work, also after COVID. Spain or LATAM preferable.
• Flexible hours.
• Join a motivated and innovative team using state of art technologies.
• Join a company with large expansion and growth projects
• Do work that makes a difference

jobs_results.title: Backend software engineer
jobs_results.description:
Perfil buscado (Hombre/Mujer)

• Collaborate with technical director, solution engineers, client managers, ensure the features are designed, and delivered according to defined business requirements and quality standards
• Responsible for core technical components development and optimization
• Implement and maintain our backend architecture for durability and quality
• Completes required coding to satisfy the defined acceptance criteria and deliver desired outcome
• Balance a fast-paced delivery schedule while ensuring quality and resilience
• Diligent to create and sustain premium quality and security of our product through modern quality tools and processes

• International Company|Important Position in the IT Department
• Bachelor´s Degree or above or commensurate industry experience.
• 7+ years of experience in Java development
• Experience with Spring / Spring Boot / Spring Cloud / Mybatis / Hibernate / JPA etc opensource framework, etc.
• Experience with high concurrency, high... availability software design and development is a plus
• Experience with code version management tools such as Git or SVN
• Experience with unit testing framework such as Junit / EasyMock / Spockframework etc
• Experience with code build tools such as Ant, Gradle or Maven etc
• Preferred but not required:
• Previous experience working for Online Travel Industry is a plus

Our client is a technology company whose mission is to make the travel business easier

through industry leading technology that empowers travel industry services. The company supports

technology for Connectivity Services at the CRS and PMS levels, Marketing Services which uses machine

learning and rich data to drive high-performing marketing campaigns and a Content platform that collects,

manages and distributes quality hotel content. Its headquarters are in the USA, with offices in Barcelona, Tokyo and Shanghai, they serve partners in 197 countries around the world.

• We offer competitive salary based on experience, annual bonuses and referral bonuses
• Peer recognition programs
• Health benefits
• Free coffee! (To recharge your batteries)
• Pension plan
• Transport and restaurant tickets
• Working from home
• Casual work environment where teamwork is key
• Nice and comfy office at the city center (Diagonal)!
• Work with passionate experts who will share their knowledge and help you develop and grow

jobs_results.title: Back-end Developer
jobs_results.description:
A Little Bit About Flanks

Flanks is a Barcelona-based fintech company focused on wealth management services. Its main product is a SaaS solution that helps financial advisors, family offices and other institutions to have a holistic view of their clients’ financial assets while using the latest scraping technology. We’re currently building the benchmark in the OpenWealth industry, and so far we managed to have compatibility with over 250 national and international entities.

Thanks to our clients, we continue to grow at a fast pace. We have already more than 300,000 aggregated portfolios spread across nearly 250 entities and have positioned our business at break-even in less than a year. In August 2021, Flanks raised €2.3 million in an investment round led by JME Ventures and SeedRocket 4Founders Capital. And a significant €7.5 million in August 2023, demonstrating confidence in our vision and capabilities.

We are pioneers in our market in Spain, which will certainly grow a lot in... the next few months and years. However, we are going to take a league leap in terms of the volumetry of the system, as our key focus now is to accelerate our market expansion in Europe and LatAm. And we would like to count on you to also grow (personally and professionally) with us.

Flanks’s values are:
• People first: To us, the most important thing is for “Flankers” to feel at ease, for them to get involved in a project and be feel part of the team.
• Keep growing: Our team believes that people growing in lockstep with the company is essential, both personally and professionally.
• Think twice, act once: We like to think about all the possible consequences before taking any decision that could affect the team or our clients.

If you’re looking to grow professionally in a very fast-growing company with an exciting start-up culture, this is your opportunity!

About The Role

You will be a Backend Developer in our company. You'll be working as a full member of the Drivers team, participating in the process of data extraction from various custodian entities. You will be working with Python as a basis and custom techniques and methodologies in order to make data extraction and processing at large scale. You will cooperate with technical and financial people in order to understand in detail what you’re processing.

Responsibilities

Examples of tasks you can expect to work on are:
• Understand and automate the login process of financial institutions websites with multi factor authentication mechanisms
• Reverse engineering of online banking websites
• All of the steps of an ETL data pipeline
• Data extraction from websites content, csv and pdf documents

Our tech stack
• Python as code base
• Browser emulation tools
• Pandas for document data parsing
• Jenkins as CI/CD
• MongoDB as data storage tool

Things we'd love to see on you
• You are a nice person: Assholes and bigotry won’t be tolerated.
• You live in Barcelona City and/or close enough to work at the office twice/three times a week. Living in Spain is a mandatory requirement, and a non-negotiable requirement.
• Likewise, we can’t offer a relocation package and/or working visa.
• You have working English and Spanish proficiency.
• You have some experience in similar roles. We're looking for someone with some lessons already learned.
• Working experience with data pipelines and scrapping.
• You are familiar with MongoDB.
• Meaningful experience with Javascript will be a huge plus.
• We will be helping you to grow, so don't worry if you don't check all the boxes!

What Can We Offer

We offer what we think is fair compensation (from 23K to 30K € per year for this role). We're on top of the market, but our intention is to increase compensation as the company grows. You will not be left behind. We believe this is a really nice time to join the project. This is a full-time, permanent contract.

A non-exhaustive list of perks includes:

🏠 Office between Sants Estació and Plaça Espanya, with a 280 degree view of Barcelona.

🔆 Flexible working hours

🎊 Paid time off on your birthday

🍒 Fresh fruit every week, all-you-can-drink tea and coffee

🍻 Friday happy hours after our weekly team meetings (optional)

😎 Team building events (optional)

🙀 Personal holidays swap inside the same month

🍽️ Digital canteen with Nora in our offices subsidized at 50%.

🏥 Health insurance

💸 Flexible remuneration with Cobee

📚 Yearly training budget

The hiring process

This is how the usual hiring process looks like:
• You send us your resume, cover letter, etc.
• A chat with our CTO Sergi Lao, where we’ll dive deeper into your background, your possible fit, and where you’ll have the opportunity to ask any sort of questions.
• We will send you a technical test so we can see how you deal with problems and how you manage Python.
• A meeting with our CTO and our CEO Joaquim de la Cruz.
• Optionally, any other meeting you or us might need to clarify any pending questions.
• We send you an offer.

We expect a few days to pass between each step. We aim for a process as short as one week and never longer than one month.

If you think you meet most of the criteria described above, don’t hesitate to send us your CV and/or cover letter. We will be happy to hear from you!

Flanks is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion both in our hiring practices and in our experiences as a Flanks employee. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage all applicants regardless of race, religion, or belief (if any), nationality, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, or disability status

• Working experience with data pipelines and scrapping.
• You are familiar with MongoDB.
• Meaningful experience with Javascript will be a huge plus.
• We will be helping you to grow, so don't worry if you don't check all the boxes!

What Can We Offer

We offer what we think is fair compensation (from 23K to 30K € per year for this role). We're on top of the market, but our intention is to increase compensation as the company grows. You will not be left behind. We believe this is a really nice time to join the project. This is a full-time, permanent contract.

A non-exhaustive list of perks includes:

🏠 Office between Sants Estació and Plaça Espanya, with a 280 degree view of Barcelona.

🔆 Flexible working hours

🎊 Paid time off on your birthday

🍒 Fresh fruit every week, all-you-can-drink tea and coffee

🍻 Friday happy hours after our weekly team meetings (optional)

😎 Team building events (optional)

🙀 Personal holidays swap inside the same month

🍽️ Digital canteen with Nora in our offices subsidized at 50%.

🏥 Health insurance

💸 Flexible remuneration with Cobee

📚 Yearly training budget

The hiring process

This is how the usual hiring process looks like:
• You send us your resume, cover letter, etc.
• A chat with our CTO Sergi Lao, where we’ll dive deeper into your background, your possible fit, and where you’ll have the opportunity to ask any sort of questions.
• We will send you a technical test so we can see how you deal with problems and how you manage Python.
• A meeting with our CTO and our CEO Joaquim de la Cruz.
• Optionally, any other meeting you or us might need to clarify any pending questions.
• We send you an offer.

We expect a few days to pass between each step. We aim for a process as short as one week and never longer than one month.

If you think you meet most of the criteria described above, don’t hesitate to send us your CV and/or cover letter. We will be happy to hear from you!

Flanks is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion both in our hiring practices and in our experiences as a Flanks employee. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage all applicants regardless of race, religion, or belief (if any), nationality, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, or disability status

jobs_results.title: Back-end Engineer (Senior)
jobs_results.description:
Filmin is a Video On Demand platform focused on independent cinema and series, novelties and classics. This approach allows Filmin to present an extensive catalog of 15,000 titles, the largest in Europe for a subscription platform and is currently operating in Spain, Portugal and México.

💻 Hard Skills
• 4+ years of PHP
• Frameworks (Symfony or Laravel)
• SOLID, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, Clean Code
• Testing (unit, integration, functional)
• SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
• Cache and queue systems (Redis, RabbitMQ)
• CI/CD knowledge
• Feel comfortable writing technical documentation

👥 Soft skills:
• Open-minded and willingness to work and collaborate within a team.
• Curiosity and eager to learn.
• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Ownership and responsibility over own code.

💡What you will do
• Be an active part in all the stages of development of new features: from the decision-making to the final delivery, applying good code practices and with special... attention to software architecture.
• Work on the continuous improvement of the applications, refactoring the actual code in order to improve the architecture, performance and scalability. Your opinion matters.
• Work in an application with high traffic distributed in a wide variety of devices (mobiles, tablets, Smart TVs, gaming consoles).
• Work in an agile environment with sprints, dailys, plannings and retrospectives.
• Pair programming, code reviews and close collaboration with other developers.
• Help us to improve the engineering culture in the company and share knowledge. You can see how we work in our blog.

☀️ What we offer
• Indefinite contract
• Salary range 40K-45K
• 3 days remote + 2 days office (in Barcelona)
• Flexible working hours
• Free Friday’s afternoon
• Free afternoons in summer
• 25 vacation days
• Weekly trainings
• Training budget
• You can choose your equipment
• Friendly environment

📱 Hiring process
• Interview with the CTO and a backend engineer (30min call)
• Technical interview (pair programming) (1h call)
• Final interview (30min call)

📍Location

Barcelona

jobs_results.description: Git, Backend, Objektorientierte Programmierung, Versicherungssoftware, IT, Informatik, Softwareentwicklung, Hardware, Datenbanken, Java We have something that will help you own: your next job! intersoft is an IT company specializing in insurance software and a wholly owned subsidiary of WWK Lebensversicherung a.G. We develop software solutions exclusively for WWK. The maintenance, modernization and expansion of our portfolio management system lifestream, which was developed especially for WWK, is our main responsibility. We are constantly on the lookout for innovative minds with ingenuity, acumen and ideas - not only to develop new IT solutions, but also to achieve common goals. In short: we're looking for you! Senior Backend Developer (m/f/d) What you bring to the table: You have sound know-how in the field of object-oriented software development with Java and have experience in the support and further development of a grown system You have conceptual design skills and are adept at... identifying, analyzing and documenting requirements - you are happy to take on testing independently after implementation You analyze the causes of problems both independently and as part of a team and enjoy cracking complex problems, researching errors and debugging You communicate complex technical content to your customers in a target group-oriented and understandable way and have a high technical and equally high professional affinity You combine your analytical, systematic and conceptual way of thinking with a high level of quality awareness and a strong focus on results You have a good sense for potential challenges, act preventively and share them with your team and stakeholders You find pragmatic and practicable solutions, are assertive and able to reach consensus You have already found your balance between focused work and team play - you enrich your team with your openness, motivation and proactivity You have trained as an IT specialist, have a degree in computer science or a comparable qualification - professional experience in insurance or finance is an advantage What you can expect at intersoft: You enjoy taking on technical challenges and always think outside the box. The fact that your implementations always combine the tried and tested with necessary innovations spurs you on to find the best possible and feasible solutions. You are passionate about sharing these results with your team and taking your product to the next level together - and you mainly do this remotely. We support you in growing in your role, bringing in your new ideas and putting them into practice - we offer you the appropriate playing field. This is what there is to do: Together with your team, you will develop software in the Provision subsystem as part of the functional expansion of WWK's core system You always keep an eye on the further development of the technical mapping of processes You have a desire to delve deeply into complex technical processes to ensure secure and valuable software in the long term Your tasks include driving forward the modernization and improvement of the maintainability of the code base through targeted refactorings - for this you develop business cases and are in close contact with the product owner You are jointly responsible for the technical requirements gathering - the evaluation, analysis and resolution of error tickets are part of your daily work, in close cooperation with your colleagues You are responsible for the quality assurance of your work and the creation of necessary technical documentation - you create automated tests, execute queries in the database and push your code changes to Git Your work does not end at the edge of your plate - in order to maintain your product, but at the same time develop it further, you work as deeply as possible into the existing system and thus build up the necessary specialist knowledge With your drive and experience, you help your team to achieve their goals and set new impulses - so you continuously increase your performance A proactive and solution-oriented way of communicating with colleagues at intersoft and WWK is part of it Convinced? Then apply for a job with us! Not convinced yet? Here are a few things that set us apart from the rest: Maximum flexibility and adaptability for employee satisfaction Symbolically open doors, flat hierarchies, family atmosphere Real teams that exchange information on a planned and spontaneous basis every day Central location and ideal transport connections Modern hardware and software equipment - whether in the office or at home Extras such as the Germany ticket, company sports, company social benefits, individual training programs Reliable job with prospects Free ice cream in the office, drinks, fruit and many other great employee benefits Good work-life balance and a pleasant working atmosphere Mobile first - as much mobile working as you want There we go, now! Sounds good? Then we should get to know each other. Please send us your application documents with your salary expectations and earliest possible starting date via our application form at ****** Your contact person in the HR Unit is Miriam. intersoft AG, Frankenstraße 18 a, 20097 Hamburg, www.intersoft.de You can find more information about the WWK Group at www.wwk.de * If you apply to us by e-mail, please note the following information: Sending by e-mail to our address ****** is usually unencrypted. This means that unauthorized access to your data cannot be ruled out. For security reasons, we recommend that you only send e-mails in encrypted form. Please do not send us any sensitive data by unencrypted e-mail. You can find our public PGP key for sending an encrypted email on our website at https://www.intersoft.de/assets/pgp_jobs.asc.txt. The fingerprint for this is: 345D F208 C278 94AF C05C 64A6 20AB 5058 0BF3 3FB5. Alternatively, you can send us your application by post. If you contact us by unencrypted e-mail, this is expressly on a voluntary basis and with your consent, Art. 6 para. 1 a GDPR. In this case, we also assume your consent to contact you via the communication channel you have chosen (unencrypted email) in order to respond to your request. If you do not wish us to do this, please let us know. You can of course withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future

jobs_results.title: Senior Back-end Developer
jobs_results.description:
Shiji Group provides software solutions and services for the hospitality, food service, retail and entertainment industries, ranging from hotel management solutions, to food and beverage and retail systems, payment gateways, data management, online distribution and more. Founded in 1998 as a network solutions provider for hotels, and later changed to a software provider for the whole consumer market, Shiji Group today comprises 5,000 employees in 80+ subsidiaries and brands, serving over 91,000 hotels, 200,000 restaurants and 600,000 retail outlets. Shiji is committed to connecting the global business of hospitality. We provide an integrated suite of technological solutions that empower hotel, retail, food, and entertainment companies to better connect with their guests.

What you’ll do

About us

We are looking for a Senior Back End Data Engineer to support our ReviewPro team, the world-leaders in Guest Intelligence solutions for the hospitality industry. ReviewPro cloud-based... solutions enable 60,000+ clients to obtain a deeper understanding of reputation performance and operational/service strengths and weaknesses, providing actionable insight to increase guest satisfaction, rankings on review sites/OTAs and ultimately, revenue.

ReviewPro provides detailed insight through superior data and advanced analytics accessible through easy-to-use tools and a flexible API. The experienced team delivers industry-leading training and education and is committed to providing a first-rate, personalized service. We are focused on empowering clients to make the changes necessary to create a guest-centric culture within their organizations.

About you

You are a talented developer who loves solving challenging algorithmic, distributed system, and large data set problems.

The role

As a senior member of the team, you will be responsible for designing systems that process billions of reviews, time-series data, semantic mentions, surveys, and responses daily. You will develop cognitive services that extract meaning and insights from this data. What you create will be used by over 60,000+ hotels worldwide to gain knowledge, visibility, and insight into their guests' experience.

Our technology stack includes:
• Microservices based architecture
• Java, Python, and NodeJS -- this role, in particular, has a focus on Java with Spring Boot/Cloud
• Kafka, Elasticsearch, Mongo, Cassandra, and Mysql persistence
• MapReduce and stream-based data processing

What we are looking for

Qualifications

This is a senior-level position, and as such, we're looking for developers who have experience in some, but not all of our technology stack. Of particular importance is the ability to demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and an understanding of algorithmic time and space complexity. Experience working on distributed systems is a plus.

What else we offer
• Flexible work schedule
• Free coffee
• Subsidized gym membership
• Office located in the center of Barcelona on Pasiege de Gracia
• International team
• Knowledge exchange: we attend conferences and community events as well as provide learning resources
• Nice equipment: Mac laptops, high-quality monitors (1 or 2, the choice is yours)
• Desks with adjustable height (standing desks)
